listSrc: Michigan Department of State, Bureau of Elections (MVIC Election Results)

items.t: Implemented new voting rights for eligible Michiganders before the 2020 election, including the right to vote absentee.
items.q: She also implemented new voting rights for all eligible Michiganders prior to the 2020 election, including the right to vote absentee

items.t: Oversaw more than 250 audits after the 2020 election.
items.q: oversaw more than 250 audits after the election, all of which affirmed its integrity and accuracy.

items.t: Advocates for allowing service members and spouses serving overseas to return their ballots electronically.
items.q: She continues to advocate for the state Legislature to allow service members and their spouses serving overseas to return their ballots electronically to ensure they are received in time to be counted.

items.t: Chairs Michigan's Task Force on Women in Sports, which was created in 2019 to advance opportunities for women as athletes and sports leaders.
items.q: Secretary Benson is the Chair of Michigan's Task Force on Women in Sports, created by Governor Gretchen Whitmer in 2019 to advance opportunities for women in Michigan as athletes and sports leaders.

items.t: Doubled the number of Secretary of State services available online and installed more than 160 self-service stations statewide.
items.q: She doubled the number of services available online, installed more than 160 self-service stations statewide

items.t: Ended the take-a-ticket-and-wait system at Secretary of State offices.
items.q: ended the take-a-ticket-and-wait system that had resulted in hours-long lines at offices for years.

items.t: Has repeatedly called on the state Legislature to meet the transparency standards modeled by the Department of State.
items.q: has repeatedly called on the state Legislature to rise to the standards of transparency modeled by the Department of State under her leadership.
